scripts.railway:build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.railway:build:auto: sh -c 'target="${RAILWAY_APP_TARGET:-${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-frontend}}"; case "$target" in backend|*backend*) npm run railway:build:backend ;; *) npm run railway:build:frontend ;; esac'
scripts.railway:start:auto: sh -c 'target="${RAILWAY_APP_TARGET:-${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-frontend}}"; case "$target" in backend|*backend*) npm run railway:start:backend ;; *) npm run railway:start:frontend ;; esac'
